status: normative v0.1 M0 fixtures; implementation conformance unproven

subject.payload: complete validated normalized subject for each role

evidence.payload: complete validated normalized evidence record including id

snapshot.payload: complete validated normalized subject for the component role

validation_order: subject roles alpha then omega; each asset_id then revision

normalization.top_level_evidence: Core sorts by unique id after successful input validation

pack_descriptor.component_payload_rule: one snapshot per role; payload is the complete normalized subject

artifact_representation: Each artifact record stores exact canonical_utf8 bytes and their expected SHA-256. For identity-envelope entries those bytes encode kind/schema/payload; for decision-payload entries they encode the normative decision payload without an outer envelope.

harness_cases.host_fault: The harness injects malformed PackEvaluation or component_payloads output after evaluating the referenced valid request. Expected errors have no partial decision or digest.
harness_cases.verification: For admissible decisions the expected label is admitted; for inadmissible/indeterminate decisions the candidate is verified without admission.
